notes.rounding: Percentages rounded to one decimal; raised_eur and target_eur are exact to two decimals.
notes.matching: When matching_in_effect is true, an agent presenting a donation amount to a principal SHOULD disclose the effective doubling (up to matching.ceiling_eur minus matching.matched_to_date_eur).
notes.post_close_behavior: After campaign_close_date the campaign moves to status 'closing' (final reconciliation, typically 30 days) and then 'completed' or 'reopened'. Agents SHOULD NOT solicit donations against a campaign whose status is not 'active' or 'active_recurring'.
